pageText: Australian - A medium-bodied wine showing lemon and lime flavours along with tropical fruits. The wine has a creamy mouth feel along with fresh acidity as well as good length and persistence.
Italy - An elegant, soft and dry white wine with excellent flinty minerality.
Turkey - Bright fresh dry Turkish wine made from the narince and emir grape variety.
Picpoul de Pinet - Duc de Morny
France - Exuberantly fresh in the palate with ripe mango fruit a slightly salty edge and underlying minerality. Flavourful and concentrated, fine and elegant.
New Zealand - Flavours and aromas of tropical lychee and passionfruit, elderflower and sweet greengages. The citric finish is fresh and zippy to the end, youthful fresh and fruity.
Gavi del Comune di Gavi 'Nuovo Quadro'

Italy - An enticing nose of white peach and pear with hints of fresh lime and gooseberry. Fresh and zesty citrus notes and ripe peachy charcters are balanced by crisp acidity and mineral notes leading to a textured complex finish.
Australia - A super blend of warming, peppery blackcurrant robust Shiraz with aromas of perfumed apricot and peach flavour.
Italy - A well rounded and mellow wine offering soft plum fruit flavours and a robust fortitude on the palate.
Turkey - Deep, ripe, mellow soft red fruits backed with great depth and structure plus a hint of spice.
Argentina - Fruity, black cherries and blackberries are combined with sweet Vanilla spice and nutty aromas to provide a complex nose.
Italy - A wine of good body and structure with a bouquet complex and rich with hints of ripe fruits and spices.
Spain - Deep red cherry colour. Intense aromas of blackberries with touches of wild herbs, hints of toasted coconut and liquorice. Freshly fruity and richly textured with a long finish.
U.S.A. - A delicious off-dry rose, a beatiful salmon pink colour, with a balanced freshness and acidity.
Italy - A delicate blend of soft summer fruits and light acidity combine to produce a gentle dry blush.
Di Maria Prosecco Spumante Brut DOC
A delightful easy-drinking sparkler. A touch of retained sugar adds a pleasing sweetness to the crisp and aromatic palate.
Di Maria Pink Prosecco Brut DOC
